Session date: 11:46 am on 30 August, 2023
[D23:3] Jolene: This country was awesome! It showed me different kinds of yoga and their backgrounds, which made me appreciate it even more. We visited a lot of delicious cafes! Have you ever been somewhere that was important to you?
[D23:4] Deborah: Yep, last month I visited my mom`s house which holds a special place in my heart. My mom had good and bad times there, but it's still a symbol of her strength and the love she shared with me. This is my husband in front of this house.
[D23:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man standing in front of a house
[D23:5] Jolene: What was it like?
[D23:6] Deborah: It brought back fond memories as I relaxed outside.
[D23:7] Jolene: Sounds great! So glad you have a place to relax and find peace.
[D23:8] Deborah: Thanks, Jolene. It's special for me. How about you? Is there a place that helps you relax?
[D23:9] Jolene: I go to this nearby place to meditate by a tranquil spot.
[D23:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a pond with lily pads and a tree in the background
[D23:10] Deborah: Looks chill. What's been the effect of that?
[D23:11] Jolene: It helps me make sense of everything and relieves stress. It's like a restart.
[D23:12] Deborah: Cool, glad you found a place to chill. We all need that occasionally. This is one of my favorite spots to ponder and let things go.

[D23:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a lake with a few trees in the water
[D23:13] Jolene: Looks great! What made you pick that spot?
[D23:14] Deborah: The soothing vibes and nice views made it ideal for reflecting and letting go.
[D23:15] Jolene: Here is one more photo from Rio de Janeiro. We went on many excursions there.
[D23:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people walking up a set of stairs
[D23:16] Deborah: Wow, those stairs look cool! Where were they taken?
[D23:17] Jolene: We had a great time visiting an old temple. The stairs were amazing!
[D23:18] Deborah: Wow, exploring those temples must have been incredible! Three years ago I was also in Rio de Janeiro, I took a beautiful photo on one of the excursions.
[D23:18] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a large stone structure with a mountain in the background
[D23:19] Jolene: The architecture and history of it all were really interesting. I'm sure you also liked the places you visited there!
[D23:20] Deborah: Exploring historical places and learning their stories is so fun. It was a great experience. I want to share this photo with you.
[D23:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a hand holding a piece of paper with writing on it
[D23:21] Jolene:  By the way, what did that paper have written on it in the photo?
[D23:22] Deborah: This was written to me by a friend who, unfortunately, will never be able to support me. I miss him here. This quote says"Let go of what no longer serves you."
[D23:23] Jolene: I'm sorry! That's a good reminder to stay focused and let go of what no longer serves us. Remember the quote in my notebook? It also inspires me!
[D23:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notebook with a quote on it
[D23:24] Deborah: What other quotes give you strength?
[D23:25] Jolene: I came across this one while browsing and it really hit home with me. It's a great reminder to ditch the negative stuff and focus on growing and being positive.
[D23:25] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notebook with a pen and a plant on a table
[D23:26] Deborah: Surrounding ourselves with good stuff and striving to improve is key.
[D23:27] Jolene: Yep, Deborah! It's about creating a good atmosphere to help us grow and improve. By the way, I have a new plant.
[D23:27] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a plant in a pot on a patio
[D23:28] Deborah: What made you pick it?
[D23:29] Jolene: I got this as a reminder to nurture myself and embrace fresh starts.
[D23:30] Deborah: Nice job, Jolene! Take care of yourself and embrace new beginnings.
[D23:31] Jolene: Thanks Deb! Will do. Good talking to you. Take care!
[D23:32] Deborah: Have a great day!
Session date: 2:14 pm on 3 September, 2023
[D24:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene, just catching up. I went to a cool event last week with the aim to support each other - pretty inspiring. Have you been connecting with anyone lately?
[D24:2] Jolene: Hey Deb, great to hear from you! I've been focusing on studying and my relationship with my partner. We're taking little trips to the beach, it's a great way to relax. How about you, anything new going on?
[D24:3] Deborah: I was busy too - went to a community meetup last Friday. We shared stories and it was nice to feel how connected we are. It made me think about how important relationships are. How about you, how are things going in that area?
[D24:4] Jolene: I'm really thankful for my significant other right now. It's great to have someone encouraging my goals! How are things with your friends and family? Any updates on that front?
[D24:5] Deborah: Relationships with family and friends are so vital. My yoga pals have been my second family - we've held each other up through a lot. The other day I found this old photo. That was when I first started doing yoga. My mum was my biggest fan and source of motivation. She'd often come to my classes with me.
[D24:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman sitting on a yoga mat with two children
[D24:6] Jolene: Our loved ones sure are supportive! When I was 10, my parents got me that and it was the start of my passion for video games.
[D24:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a nintendo game console and a game controller
[D24:7] Deborah: Cool that they shared that with you. Did you learn on your own or did they teach you?
[D24:8] Jolene: I taught myself, but my dad was always supportive and my mom would play games with me. 
[D24:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a nintendo wii game system with a game on the screen
[D24:9] Deborah: That's awesome! Sounds like you had a lot of support from your parents. What was your favorite game to play with mom?
[D24:10] Jolene: One of my favorites was "Monster Hunter: World". The immersive story and open-world gaming are amazing!
[D24:11] Deborah:  It can be so freeing when you get immersed in a game like that. 
[D24:12] Jolene: Yeah! It's my way to de-stress and take a break from life.
[D24:13] Deborah: What's up this month? Anything fun happening for you?
[D24:14] Jolene: Got a lot of finals coming up this month, so I've been studying real hard. It's been quite stressful, but it'll be worth it in the end. Thinking about taking a trip somewhere to relax and recharge afterward.
[D24:15] Deborah: Good luck with it! Let me know if there's anything I can do to assist you.
Session date: 8:31 pm on 6 September, 2023
[D25:1] Jolene: Woohoo! I signed up for a meditation course at a retreat near a lake. Can't wait to share this experience with my partner and learn some new techniques. Sooo excited!
[D25:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a building with a curved roof on a hill
[D25:2] Deborah: That`s awesome! It looks so calm in the pic - I hope you enjoy your experience and learn some new techniques!

[D25:4] Deborah: Yep, it's become part of my routine now. Can't imagine my life without it.

passages.text:
Session date: 12:52 am on 19 August, 2023
[D19:8] Jolene: I have a few game recommendations. Zelda BOTW for Switch is an awesome open-world game. Animal Crossing: New Horizons is really calming and cute. As for my favorite game, it's hard to choose just one!
[D19:9] Deborah: Cool recs! I'll definitely check those out. What about your favorite memories of playing video games?

[D19:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man and a woman sitting in a chair in front of a computer
[D19:10] Jolene: Oh, I forgot to mention Overcooked 2 - this is a good co-op game if you're into hilarious and chaotic cooking. My partner and I often play for bets! I once won three large pizzas!
[D19:11] Deborah: Reminds me of when I used to play games with my husband. We'd take turns and it was a great way to bond and make memories. Gaming really can bring people closer, right?
[D19:12] Jolene: Yeah, you`re right! What's your favorite game to play with that person?
[D19:13] Deborah: We prefer to play detective games together.
[D19:14] Jolene: What other activities do you both enjoy doing together?
[D19:15] Deborah: We also enjoyed spending time outdoors and exploring nature. It was always so refreshing to be outside and soak up the fresh air.
[D19:16] Jolene: I'm a big fan of being outside too! It's so calming and refreshing. Do you have any special spots you like to go to?
[D19:17] Deborah: I love going to this park near my house - it has a nice forest trail and a beach. It's a peaceful spot where I can do some yoga and reflect. There's also a special bench that holds special meaning to me.
[D19:18] Jolene: Sounds lovely! Nature can be calming. What makes this bench special to you?
[D19:18] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bench in a park with a tree in the background
[D19:19] Deborah: It holds a lot of special memories for me and my mom - we would come here and chat about dreams and life. It's full of good moments. 
[D19:19] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person sitting on a bench in a forest
[D19:20] Jolene: That's awesome, Deborah! What were some of your favorite memories with your mom at this spot? It looks super peaceful and pretty.
[D19:21] Deborah: I'll always cherish my memories with her at this spot. I remember a beautiful sunset we watched together in silence - the colors in the sky were so special. Every time I go back, I feel so much peace and gratitude for the time I spent with her.
[D19:22] Jolene: Places and moments like that can mean so much, and it's a gift to find peace and gratitude in them.
[D19:23] Deborah:  I'm really thankful for all the time we had.
[D19:24] Jolene: It's so important to cherish it. 
Session date: 9:11 am on 21 August, 2023
[D20:1] Jolene:  Long time no talk! We were given a new game for the console last week, it is Battlefield 1. What's been up with you?
[D20:2] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Good to hear from you. That`s cool! Been thinking about a few big moments lately - went to a place that held a lot of memories for me. Sat on a bench where we used to chat and it brought back a lot of emotions. 
[D20:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a flower cart on a sidewalk with flowers in it
[D20:3] Jolene: Mostly happy or a bit of everything?
[D20:4] Deborah: It was quite a mix, Jolene. I felt nostalgia and longing, but also grateful for the memories. It's amazing how a place can mean so much. I brought these flowers there.
[D20:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a vase of flowers on the ground in a street
[D20:5] Jolene: Do you think she would like it?
[D20:6] Deborah: Yeah, my mom really loved flowers. They always made her so happy. She appreciated the simple things in life.

[D20:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman holding a bouquet of red roses
[D20:7] Jolene: Wow, that's a great photo! How did she show you to appreciate it?
[D20:8] Deborah: By taking it slow, seeing beauty in them, and finding joy.
[D20:9] Jolene: Wow Deb, that's awesome! We should definitely take time to enjoy that and not let the business of life cause us to miss out on the good stuff.
[D20:10] Deborah: Yeah, Jolene. Life can be so busy that we often overlook the small things that truly matter. Let's make an effort to appreciate them more.
[D20:11] Jolene: Yep Deb, slowing down and enjoying simple moments can bring a lot of balance and happiness. I'm trying to do more yoga and meditation myself to help relax and stay focused. Are there any calming habits that you practice to feel balanced?
[D20:12] Deborah: Yeah, same here, Jolene! Yoga and meditation help me find balance and inner peace. Going out for walks and staying mindful also keep me grounded. I take similar photos on walks.
[D20:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a sunset over a body of water
[D20:13] Jolene: Gorgeous! Going for a walk and feeling so peaceful must be amazing.
[D20:14] Deborah: Moments like that I'll always cherish.
[D20:15] Jolene: That calm and peaceful feeling is so nice - it's great for recharging and thinking.
[D20:16] Deborah:  It's like a reboot for me.
[D20:17] Jolene: Got it! It's like hitting the refresh button and coming back even better.
[D20:17] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a green cushion on a floor in front of a window
[D20:18] Deborah: What's your favorite yoga pose for some rest?
[D20:19] Jolene: I'm a fan of savasana - aka the corpse pose. It's so calming and helps me just let go and surrender.
[D20:19] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person laying on the floor with a paper bag
[D20:20] Deborah: Funny photo! How long have you been doing yoga?
[D20:21] Jolene: Been doing it for 3 years. It's a great way to escape studying and work stress.
[D20:22] Deborah: Wow, Jolene! Taking time to unwind is key and that seems just right for you!
[D20:23] Jolene: I'm really finding my zen again!
[D20:24] Deborah: Keep it up!
[D20:25] Jolene: Thanks for your support, Deb! 
[D20:26] Deborah: Good luck with everything. Stay in touch.
Session date: 9:34 am on 24 August, 2023
[D21:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Good to hear from you! A lot's happened since we talked - last week I got to go to this yoga retreat near my mom's place. It was so cool - I got to hang with nature and really get to know myself. Definitely life-changing! That's how beautiful it was there!
[D21:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a trail in a forest with moss and trees
[D21:2] Jolene: Wow, Deb, sounds great! Glad you got to connect with yourself and nature. That's my own way to relax. What are your thoughts on life now?
[D21:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man bending over on a blanket in the grass
[D21:3] Deborah: Life's been super meaningful lately. Nature and self-reflection have helped me see how beautiful every moment is. We can really grow and learn when we listen to ourselves. What's been up with you lately? Any insights or experiences?

[D21:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a mountain range with a colorful sunset in the background
[D21:4] Jolene: Life's been hectic, but I'm making strides toward my goals. It's tough, but satisfying.
[D21:5] Deborah: Can you tell me a bit more about it and what you've achieved?

passages.title: LoCoMo conv-48 history chunk 13
passages.text:
Session date: 3:09 pm on 15 September, 2023
[D28:5] Deborah: Wow, it was so special. A glimpse into her life beyond what I knew. Through their eyes, I appreciate her more. Here I am and my mom.
[D28:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two women in pajamas taking a selfie in a mirror
[D28:6] Jolene: That looks like a blast! What did you and your mom's friends do on that day?
[D28:7] Deborah: We reminisced and looked through her photos. It was really sweet.
[D28:8] Jolene: Looking at old photos must have been so nostalgic! It's great that you could share that experience with friends. It's amazing how photos and memories can give us a deeper appreciation for the people we love.
[D28:9] Deborah: Pictures really have a way of bringing back memories and making us appreciate the special bond we have with our loved ones. They remind me of how strong love is and how amazing human relationships can be. Just like this one.
[D28:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D28:10] Jolene: Wow, what a gorgeous pic! Do you have any special memories of that beach or just love surfing in general?
[D28:11] Deborah: That beach is super special to me. It's where I got married and discovered my love for surfing. It's always filled with joy and peace.
[D28:12] Jolene: What pleasant memories.
[D28:13] Deborah: Here is another photo from my classes.
[D28:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on the beach
[D28:14] Jolene: Wow, that yoga pose looks amazing! Does it help you relax?
[D28:15] Deborah: Oh yeah! Doing this on the beach is so peaceful - the ocean, sand, and fresh air create a super relaxing atmosphere. The perfect way to take care of myself.
[D28:16] Jolene:  I like to create my own serene yoga space with candles and oils for extra chill vibes. Also, we tried a new style of meditation in Thailand - with flowers.
[D28:16] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a couple of towels sitting on top of a table
[D28:17] Deborah: Oh, same for me!
[D28:18] Jolene: I find calm when I do yoga or meditate. I use essential oils and put on some soft, soothing music in the background to create a peaceful atmosphere. It really helps me chill out and center myself.
[D28:19] Deborah:  It's amazing how our environment can enhance our practice.
[D28:20] Jolene: Yeah, totally! Our surroundings can really affect our mood and how much zen we can get from our routine. Creating a place that feels safe and chill is key.
[D28:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bed with a colorful blanket and pillows
[D28:21] Deborah: Wow, that looks so comfy and inviting! Where do you usually go to relax in your house?

[D28:24] Jolene:  Here are my pals keeping me company.
[D28:24] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person holding a snake in a container
[D28:25] Deborah: Hey, that's Susie or Seraphim? How long has he been hanging out with you?
[D28:26] Jolene: It`s Susie! I've had her for two years now. 
[D28:27] Deborah: It's awesome how pets can bring us comfort and peace when we need it.
[D28:28] Jolene: Susie is a great companion.
[D28:29] Deborah: The love pets give is priceless.
[D28:30] Jolene: Plus, they make life a lot brighter!
Session date: 1:24 pm on 17 September, 2023
[D29:1] Deborah: Hey Jolene, I'm so excited to tell you! Yesterday, me and my neighbor ran a free gardening class for the community, it was awesome! People of any age joined in and it was such a great thing to see.
[D29:2] Jolene: Wow, Deborah, that's awesome! Keep up the great work, and here's hoping for more events like this in the future!
[D29:3] Deborah:  Gardening is really amazing. It brings us together in such a cool way. It was awesome to share my love of plants and help people take care of the world. So, what about you? Anything new happened lately?
[D29:4] Jolene: We tried a scuba diving lesson last Friday and had an awesome time! We found a cool dive spot we can explore together. Trying new things opens up a world of adventure - maybe one day I'll be a certified diver. Anything fun going on with you?
[D29:5] Deborah: That sounds amazing, Jolene! I've been interested in underwater life, but I haven't had the chance to try scuba diving yet. Recently, I've been spending time remembering my mom. Last Sunday, I visited her old house and sat on a bench. It was a comforting experience, as if I could feel her presence guide me and remind me of her love.
[D29:6] Jolene: Visiting your mom's old home sounds like it was really special. Is there something special you remember about her?
[D29:7] Deborah: Thanks, Jolene! It was really special. My mom had a big passion for cooking. She would make amazing meals for us, each one full of love and warmth. I can still remember the smell of her special dish, it would fill the house and bring us all together.
[D29:7] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bowl of food with a spoon in it
[D29:8] Jolene: Mmm, that looks delicious, Deb! So sweet how cooking with your mom brought everyone together. What's your best memory of cooking with her?
[D29:9] Deborah: I loved it when she would bake pineapple birthday cakes for me when I was a kid. It always made me feel so special.
[D29:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a pineapple cake with a smiley face on it
[D29:10] Jolene: No wonder it made you feel special. 
[D29:11] Deborah: Have you ever had something like that with someone close?
[D29:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a mixer with a whisk in it
[D29:12] Jolene: I used to bake cookies with someone close to me.
[D29:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of four chocolate chip cookies on a baking sheet
[D29:13] Deborah: What's your favorite cookie to make?
[D29:14] Jolene: The warm, gooey chocolate and soft, buttery cookie are a match made in heaven.
[D29:15] Deborah: I really want to eat this now.
[D29:16] Jolene: Well look what I have here!
[D29:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person holding a book open on a bed
[D29:17] Deborah:  Is there anything special about it or the photo?
[D29:18] Jolene: It takes me to another world when I read it!
[D29:19] Deborah: Did I show you that I have a big bookshelf too?
[D29:19] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a living room with a couch and a book shelf
[D29:20] Jolene: I think not, I really like it!
[D29:21] Deborah: Having a space like this is important for escaping reality and relaxing with a book. Do you have any books that really moved you?
[D29:21] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bathroom with a black and white wall and a wooden stool
[D29:22] Jolene: My bathroom has an aesthetic vibe. Once I read a self-discovery book there and it really resonated with me.
[D29:23] Deborah: Wow! A special book that speaks to you and helps with self-discovery? That's awesome. Plus, having a cozy nook to chill? That's my best one!
[D29:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D29:24] Jolene: Sounds nice, Deb! A cozy nook is a must! The beach is a great place for finding peace and relaxation. Have you ever tried surfing?

passages.text:
Session date: 4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023
[D7:16] Deborah:  Always rooting for you. Remember to listen to your heart and take good care. Here's a photo I took while reflecting outdoors. It's a reminder to find peace even in chaos.
[D7:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person sitting on a bench looking at the sunset
[D7:17] Jolene:  I'm curious, what does your daily routine look like?
[D7:18] Deborah: In the morning, I meditate, do yoga, and teach classes. And yesterday I went for a morning jog for the first time in a nearby park. I will now incorporate this into my daily routine. And in the evenings, I spend time with loved ones.
[D7:19] Jolene: Why did you decide that?
[D7:20] Deborah: Exercise is key for me - it makes me feel connected to my body. 
[D7:21] Jolene: This is a great healthy habit!
[D7:22] Deborah: It's like they say - "Can't pour from an empty cup." Looking out for ourselves gives us the energy to help others. And don't forget, you're worth it too!
[D7:23] Jolene: Thanks, Deb. Your words really mean something to me. I'll keep remembering to prioritize self-care.
Session date: 7:18 pm on 2 March, 2023

[D8:3] Deborah: Have you been able to find time for yourself lately?
[D8:4] Jolene: I've been trying to squeeze in some me-time. Last Friday, I did yoga and meditation to relax. Did you find time for yourself too?
[D8:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a room with a wooden floor and a window
[D8:5] Deborah:  I also did the same, it helped me reset my mind. How does it make you feel?
[D8:6] Jolene: It's amazing how a few quiet moments can work wonders for the soul.
[D8:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a purse with a plant on a table
[D8:7] Deborah: Have you been able to get outside lately?
[D8:8] Jolene: I did take Seraphim to the park last Sunday. She loved it and here's a pic.
[D8:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a lizard laying on the ground surrounded by leaves
[D8:9] Deborah: Looks like you guys had fun!
[D8:10] Jolene: We explored new places. People are surprised when they see a tamed snake. What do you like about being outdoors?
[D8:11] Deborah: Hmm... The birds chirping and the breeze gently blowing! It reminds me of what really matters.
[D8:12] Jolene: Yep, it's like a reminder to slow down and appreciate the little things.
[D8:13] Deborah: Is there anything you want to be more mindful of right now?
[D8:14] Jolene: I need to be more mindful of my stress levels and take care of my mental health. Sometimes I get too caught up in my studies and forget to prioritize self-care.
[D8:15] Deborah:  Life can get hectic and it's easy to forget about ourselves. 
[D8:16] Jolene: Exams and deadlines got me feeling overwhelmed. Just look at my to-do list! It seems never-ending... Trying my best but it's been challenging.
[D8:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a desk with a notebook and a computer monitor
[D8:17] Deborah: Your efforts will bear fruit, don't give up!
[D8:18] Jolene: Thanks, Deb. Any tips on studying or time management?
[D8:19] Deborah: My tip is to break it into smaller pieces and set goals for yourself. For time management, planners or schedulers help you stay organized and give you time for yourself. Let me know if you need help with a study plan!
[D8:20] Jolene: I appreciate your help with that.
[D8:21] Deborah: Take care and good luck with your exams. I'll give you a mug just like this one! It encourages.
[D8:21] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a yellow coffee cup with a handwritten message
[D8:22] Jolene: Thanks, Deb! This really cheered me up. All the best with your classes. Bye!
[D8:23] Deborah: Thanks, Jolene! Glad I could bring a smile to your face. Take care and make sure to give yourself some time to relax. Bye!
Session date: 11:22 am on 13 March, 2023
[D9:1] Deborah: Hi Jolene! We haven't corresponded for a long time!
[D9:2] Jolene: Hey Deb, yeah life can get chaotic. How's it been going lately?
[D9:3] Deborah: So much has been going on lately. I started this yoga class in the neighborhood - it's such a good feeling! Now I get to share the exercise with my neighbors and watch it really transform them.
[D9:4] Jolene:  Congrats. How did you do this?

[D9:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of women posing for a picture
[D9:6] Jolene: That's cool! What made you want to start teaching it?
[D9:7] Deborah: I find it calming and wanted to share that with others. Giving people peace and awareness brings me so much happiness.
[D9:8] Jolene: Wow, Deb! It's awesome when we can share something we love and make things better for others.
[D9:9] Deborah: Teaching it is awesome because it can help others and I've made such great friends through it. It's really nice for building community connections.
[D9:10] Jolene: That's really motivating. It's great to have support in tough times.
[D9:11] Deborah: It's one of life's best parts, right?
[D9:12] Jolene: Yeah, having someone to rely on is key in tough times. It really makes a difference in how we handle life. Plus, there's something I wanted to tell you.

[D9:19] Deborah:  I'm here for you if you need me. Let's catch up soon.

[D3:4] Deborah: That's awesome, Jolene! You're enjoying the process. It must be really satisfying to see it come together. Keep up the good work! Oh, by the way, I met my new neighbor Anna yesterday!
[D3:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a yellow sign with a picture of a family

Session date: 9:48 am on 4 February, 2023
[D4:1] Jolene: Hey Deborah! Good to hear from you. How've you been? I've been on an emotional rollercoaster lately, but I'm coping.
[D4:2] Deborah: Hey Jolene! Good to hear from you. All good here - how about you? Anything new happening lately?
[D4:3] Jolene: I had a major milestone last week and it went really well - I'm so relieved and proud. It was a huge accomplishment for me as an engineer.
[D4:4] Deborah: That's awesome. You must have worked really hard for that. I'm so proud of you. Care to share more about it?
[D4:5] Jolene: Thanks so much! I had to plan and research a lot to design and build a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need. It was tough, but I loved the experience.
[D4:6] Deborah: Your engineering skills really made a difference for people in a rural area. That's amazing! How did it feel when you saw it working?
[D4:7] Jolene: It was such a surreal moment. Seeing it working and providing clean water to the community was incredibly satisfying. It reminded me of how engineering can make a difference in people's lives. It made me feel like I had a purpose and had done something good.
[D4:8] Deborah: So, what are your career aspirations now?
[D4:9] Jolene:  I want to keep working in engineering and continue to make a positive impact on communities in need by creating sustainable solutions. My goal is to contribute towards making the world a better place with my work.
[D4:10] Deborah:  I'm sure great things will keep coming your way. Keep up the good work and follow your passions!
[D4:11] Jolene: Your support means a lot. I'm determined to keep going and make a difference. Your encouragement really motivates me to pursue my passions.
[D4:12] Deborah: When things get tough, just take a deep breath and remember why you're doing this. This is where I spend a lot of my time, teaching yoga. It's a great way to find balance and reconnect with ourselves. I bonded with Anna during yesterday's l yoga class.
[D4:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two women in a dance studio doing a dance pose
[D4:13] Jolene: Wow, that's awesome! What new poses did you try?
[D4:14] Deborah: We were trying out different dance poses, like Warrior II, which builds strength and boosts focus.
[D4:14] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on a chair
[D4:15] Jolene: Is it difficult to do?
[D4:16] Deborah: Yes, but this brought us closer to Anna! We supported each other, that means a lot.
[D4:17] Jolene: Can you explain how to do it?
[D4:18] Deborah: Sure! To do this modified pose, sit on the edge of a chair with your feet planted. Twist your torso to one side and use your hand on your knee for support. You'll feel a stretch in your back and shoulders as you hold it for a few breaths, then switch sides. It's great for relaxing tense muscles.
[D4:19] Jolene: Sounds really hard! Here's my bookshelf!
[D4:19] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book shelf with a lot of books on it
[D4:20] Deborah: That's quite a collection! Have you had a favorite book lately? I'd love to hear your thoughts.
[D4:21] Jolene: Thanks Deborah! I'm really into this book called "Sapiens" - it's a fascinating look at human history and how technology has affected us. It's giving me a lot to think about!
[D4:22] Deborah: Great, this is interesting! Have you come across any recent ones that really struck you?
[D4:23] Jolene: Two weeks ago I read "Avalanche" by Neal Stephenson in one sitting! 
[D4:24] Deborah: That sounds cool, Jolene. Stories can be so powerful - they can teach us, motivate us, and bring us together. 
[D4:25] Jolene: I also read a recent story about someone who became successful despite facing numerous challenges. It really showed me that anything is possible if you believe and work hard.
[D4:26] Deborah: That's a really powerful message. It reminds me of someone special and their grace and strength when they faced hardships. Check out this creation!
[D4:26] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bouquet of flowers in a vase on a table
[D4:27] Jolene: Wow, Deb! That's beautiful! Can you tell me the backstory of that bouquet?
[D4:28] Deborah: My friend gave me this bouquet when I was struggling, and it gives me hope and courage. I'm filled with warmth and appreciation when I look at it.
[D4:29] Jolene: That's really sweet. Such a small thing can make a real difference.
[D4:30] Deborah: It's amazing how something as simple as flowers can make a real difference. Nature sure is beautiful.
[D4:31] Jolene: Where are some of your favorite nature spots?
[D4:32] Deborah: Oh, there's so many great places! My favorite is a park with a forest trail - it's so calming getting lost in nature. Then there's this beach nearby that I love - the sound of the waves and the sand under my feet make me feel all peaceful and happy. Do you have any favorite spots, Jolene?
[D4:33] Jolene: Here's a picture I took on vacation last summer in Bogota. It was so beautiful and calming watching the sunset over the water. It definitely made me appreciate nature's calming power.
[D4:33] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D4:34] Deborah: That sounds great, Jolene. Nature's calming for sure. Guess it helps us forget the daily craziness and find inner peace. No wonder you're a fan! I like to come to this spot by the water near my mom's old house. It's where I reflect on her life and find some peace. Being surrounded by nature helps a lot.
[D4:34] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a small island with a lone boat in the water
[D4:35] Jolene: That's so touching! Do you have any little traditions that you do when you come to reflect on your mom?
[D4:36] Deborah: Do you remember this amulet from her? Whenever I come here, I bring it with me. It's how I feel her love and stay close to her. Holding it brings me comfort.
[D4:36] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman wearing a white shirt and a gold chain necklace
[D4:37] Jolene: It's amazing how something so small can have such a big impact, huh?
[D4:38] Deborah: Yeah, even small things like this can make a big difference. It's a reminder of all the love and strength we have inside, connecting us to people we've lost and comforting us.
[D4:39] Jolene: It can keep them close in our hearts every day.
[D4:40] Deborah: Anna also has a pendant that she wears in memory of her mother! This also brought us closer.
[D4:41] Jolene: It's nice to have those reminders as a source of strength when we need it.
